services.name: 6 Hour Charter
services.desc: Join Silver King Charters for a great fishing trip experience in Wisconsin! The half-day trip provides all the fun of a full day of charter fishing on Lake Michigan, but we fit it comfortably into your schedule. Enjoy the best of what Milwaukee has to offer before and after your success on the water. Ideal for family trips, parties, or just a fun afternoon on the lake with your friends. For groups of MORE than 5 people, we will set you up with as many boats as needed based on your group size. If you have 10 people you will need 2 boats, 15 people 3 boats and so on. No matter your group size - from 1 up to 20 - Silver King Charters will make it a fun and safe experience for all. Come join us

blurb: Guests join Silver King Charters for trout and salmon fishing on Lake Michigan. The captains have multiple top finishes in Lake Michigan fishing tournaments. The charters have a maximum of 5 people per trip.
